_about: Voice casting for course narration. Engine: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0), run offline by tools/build-audio.py. Change a voice or speed here and rerun the build; only that character's clips regenerate. Kokoro American voices: af_heart af_bella af_nicole af_aoede af_kore af_sarah af_nova af_sky af_alloy af_jessica af_river am_fenrir am_michael am_puck am_echo am_eric am_liam am_onyx am_adam am_santa Speeds target about 160-175 words per minute, the usual pace for training narration.

tasha.note: Narrator and lead hand. Warm, confident, natural pace.

ray.note: Foreman, 28 years in. Lower, slower, weathered.

dee.note: Second-year apprentice. Younger, a touch quicker.

narrator.note: Generic crew voice, e.g. the sub's foreman.
